props.gloss_en: R' Elazar: two Torah scholars who sharpen each other in halakha -- the Holy One gives them success
R' Elazar: as it is said 'and in your majesty (vahadarcha) prosper' (Ps 45:5) -- do not read vahadarcha but vachadadcha, 'your sharpening'
R' Elazar: moreover, they rise to greatness
R' Elazar: as it is said 'prosper, ride on'
R' Elazar: one might think [the reward comes] even [to study] not for its own sake -- the verse says 'on behalf of truth'
R' Elazar: 'on behalf of truth' (Ps 45:5)
R' Elazar: one might think [the reward comes] even if he grew arrogant -- the verse says 'meekness and righteousness'
R' Elazar: 'meekness and righteousness' (Ps 45:5)
R' Elazar: and if they do so, they merit the Torah that was given with the right hand
R' Elazar: as it is said 'and your right hand shall teach you tremendous things' (Ps 45:5)
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: they merit the things stated in the Torah's right hand

what is meant by 'length of days in her right hand, in her left riches and honour' (Prov 3:16)? -- is there then no riches and honour in her right?! rather: it speaks of those who go right in it and those who go left in it
for those who go right in it [the Torah], there is length of days
...and all the more so riches and honour
for those who go left in it, there is riches and honour
for those who go left in it there is length of days -- DENIED: 'there is not length of days'
Reish Lakish: two Torah scholars who are gentle with each other in halakha -- the Holy One listens to them
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'then those who feared the Lord spoke (nidberu) one with another, and the Lord hearkened and heard' (Mal 3:16)
Reish Lakish: 'dibbur' means nothing but gentleness
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'He subdues (yadber) peoples under us' (Ps 47:4)
R' Ami, answering what 'and who think upon His name' (Mal 3:16) means: even one who planned to do a mitzva and was prevented and did not do it
R' Ami: Scripture credits him as if he did it
Rav Chinnana bar Idi: whoever performs a mitzva as it was commanded is not told bad tidings
Rav Chinnana bar Idi: as it is said 'he who keeps the commandment shall know no evil thing' (Eccl 8:5)
Rav Asi: even if the Holy One decrees a decree, he annuls it (the Hebrew does not name who annuls it)
Reish Lakish: two Torah scholars who listen to each other in halakha -- the Holy One hears their voice
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'you who dwell in the gardens, the companions listen to your voice; let me hear it' (Song 8:13)
Reish Lakish: and if they do not do so, they cause the Shekhina to depart from Israel
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'flee, my beloved, and be like a gazelle' (Song 8:14)
Reish Lakish: two Torah scholars who are 'madgilim' each other in halakha -- the Holy One loves them (Steinsaltz, after Tosafot: who cause each other to err)
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'and his banner (vediglo) over me is love' (Song 2:4)
Rava: and that is where they know the form of the teaching
Rava: and that is where they have no master in the town to learn from
Reish Lakish: the one who lends is greater than the one who gives charity
Reish Lakish: and one who puts [money] into the purse [is greater] than all of them -- here: than the lender
Reish Lakish: and one who puts [money] into the purse [is greater] than all of them -- here: than the giver of charity
Reish Lakish: if a Torah scholar is vengeful and bears a grudge like a snake -- gird him on your loins
Reish Lakish: if an am haaretz is pious -- do not dwell in his neighbourhood
Reish Lakish: whoever raises an evil dog in his house withholds kindness from his house
Reish Lakish: as it is said 'to the lamas, kindness from his friend' (Job 6:14)
Reish Lakish: for in the Greek language they call a dog 'lamas'
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: he also casts off from himself the fear of Heaven
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: as it is said 'and he forsakes the fear of the Almighty' (Job 6:14)
a woman entered a house to bake; the dog barked at her, and her fetus was dislodged
the householder: do not be afraid, its teeth have been removed and its claws have been removed
the woman: take your kindness and throw it on the thorns -- the fetus has already moved
Rav Huna: 'rejoice, young man, in your youth ... and in the sight of your eyes' (Eccl 11:9) -- up to here, the words of the evil inclination
Rav Huna: 'but know that for all these God will bring you to judgment' -- from here on, the words of the good inclination
Reish Lakish: up to here, [the verse speaks] of words of Torah
Reish Lakish: from here on, of good deeds
